title: Retry a pending identity command without duplicate effects or draft loss
description: A commander saves an identity, loses the network, preserves a pending draft through an explicit retry and reconnect, and recovers it after reload. Actual transport frames and read-only canonical receipts distinguish retransmission from duplicate logical commands.
